tool_schemas.name: listProjects
tool_schemas.description: Lists projects stored for the given workspace, optionally filtered by status, billable flag, and a case-insensitive search over project (and client) name, and returns up to `limit` results ordered by `sortBy`/`sortOrder`; pagination is cursor-based—pass the returned `cursor` to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `workspaceId` is not a `ws_…` ULID, if `limit` is outside 1–200, or if any enum parameter is invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no integration identity is authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the identity cannot access the workspace, NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ULID (ws_01H...) to list projects for.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on project name (and/or client name).

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: getTimeEntries
tool_schemas.description: Lists time entries in a workspace for the authenticated integration’s default user, optionally filtered by time range (`start`/`end`), `projectId`, and entry `status`, returning up to `limit` results sorted by `sortBy`/`sortOrder`; pagination is cursor-based via `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs, invalid enum values, `limit` outside 1–200, malformed datetimes, or an invalid range (e.g., `start` after `end`). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no integration identity is authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the identity cannot access the workspace, NOT_FOUND if the workspace (or specified project) does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ULID (ws_01H...) to query time entries in.

start.description: Start of ISO8601 datetime range filter (inclusive).

end.description: End of ISO8601 datetime range filter (exclusive or inclusive depending on backend).

projectId.description: Filter to a specific project (project ULID).

limit.description: Maximum number of time entries to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortBy.description: Field to sort time entries by.

tool_schemas.name: addTimeEntry
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new time entry in the workspace for `projectId` with the provided `startTime`/`endTime` (and optional description/billable), and returns the created time entry; if `userId` is omitted the entry is created for the authenticated integration identity’s default user. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs, malformed datetimes, or when `endTime` is not after `startTime`. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no integration identity is authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the identity cannot write time entries in the workspace or for the specified user, NOT_FOUND if the workspace, project, or user does not exist (or the project is not in the workspace), CONFLICT if the entry cannot be created due to a disallowed state (e.g., targeting an archived project), and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ULID (ws_01H...) to create the time entry in.

projectId.description: Project ULID (prj_01H...) to associate with the time entry.

startTime.description: ISO8601 start time for the time entry.

endTime.description: ISO8601 end time for the time entry.

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable.

userId.description: User ULID (usr_01H...) to create the entry for; defaults to the authenticated integration identity's default user.

tool_schemas.name: listUsers
tool_schemas.description: Lists users stored for the given workspace, optionally filtered by status and a case-insensitive search over name/email, returning up to `limit` results ordered by `sortBy`/`sortOrder`; pagination is cursor-based via `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `workspaceId` is not a `ws_…` ULID, if `limit` is outside 1–200, or if enum parameters are invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no integration identity is authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the identity cannot access the workspace, NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ULID (ws_01H...) to list users for.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on user name or email.

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: getUserTimeEntries
tool_schemas.description: Lists time entries in a workspace for the specified `userId`, optionally filtered by time range, `projectId`, and `status`, returning up to `limit` results sorted by `sortBy`/`sortOrder`; pagination is cursor-based via `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs, invalid enum values, `limit` outside 1–200, malformed datetimes, or an invalid range (e.g., `start` after `end`). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no integration identity is authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the identity cannot access the workspace or read that user’s entries, NOT_FOUND if the workspace, user, or specified project does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ULID (ws_01H...) to query time entries in.

userId.description: User ULID (usr_01H...) to list time entries for.

start.description: Start of ISO8601 datetime range filter (inclusive).

end.description: End of ISO8601 datetime range filter (exclusive or inclusive depending on backend).

projectId.description: Filter to a specific project (project ULID).

limit.description: Maximum number of time entries to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortBy.description: Field to sort time entries by.

tool_schemas.name: getSummaryReport
tool_schemas.description: Generates an aggregated summary of tracked time for a workspace over [`start`,`end`) grouped by `groupBy` (by user, by project, or by user+project), optionally restricted to specific `userIds` and/or `projectIds`, and returns the computed totals for the matching entries. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs, malformed datetimes, invalid `groupBy`, or when `start` is after `end`. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no integration identity is authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the identity cannot access the workspace or requested users/projects, NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist (or if any explicitly provided userId/projectId does not exist in the workspace), and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ULID (ws_01H...) to generate the report for.

start.description: ISO8601 start datetime for the reporting range (inclusive).

end.description: ISO8601 end datetime for the reporting range (exclusive or inclusive depending on backend).

userIds.description: Optional list of user ULIDs to include; if omitted includes all users.

projectIds.description: Optional list of project ULIDs to include; if omitted includes all projects.

groupBy.description: How to aggregate the summary totals.

tool_schemas.name: getUserTimeEntriesByName
tool_schemas.description: Resolves a workspace user by case-insensitive partial match on `userName`, then lists that user’s time entries with optional time range, `projectId`, and `status` filters, returning up to `limit` results sorted by `sortBy`/`sortOrder`; pagination is cursor-based via `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for empty `userName`, invalid ULIDs, invalid enum values, `limit` outside 1–200, malformed datetimes, or an invalid range (e.g., `start` after `end`). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no integration identity is authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the identity cannot access the workspace or that user’s entries, NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or no user matches `userName` (or the specified project does not exist), CONFLICT if the name match is ambiguous (multiple users match), and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ULID (ws_01H...) to query time entries in.

userName.description: User name query (case-insensitive; partial match allowed).

start.description: Start of ISO8601 datetime range filter (inclusive).

end.description: End of ISO8601 datetime range filter (exclusive or inclusive depending on backend).

projectId.description: Filter to a specific project (project ULID).

limit.description: Maximum number of time entries to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortBy.description: Field to sort time entries by.

tool_schemas.name: updateTimeEntry
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an existing time entry and/or performs supported lifecycle transitions (e.g., stop a running entry, delete an entry). Returns the updated time entry. Refuses updates that violate workspace FK integrity, attempt to edit a deleted entry, or create overlapping running entries for the same user. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs, malformed datetimes, when `endTime` is not after `startTime`, or when the update would violate the one-running-entry-per-user constraint; raises NOT_FOUND if the entry does not exist in the workspace; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no integration identity is authenticated for the request.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ULID (ws_01H...) that owns the time entry.

projectId.description: Project ULID (prj_01H...) to associate with the time entry (or set to null if supported by upstream).

endTime.description: Updated ISO8601 end time; set to null to mark entry as running when allowed.

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable.

status.description: Lifecycle transition for the entry: `running`↔`stopped` (stop/start when supported) or `deleted` to remove. Transition rules apply (e.g., `deleted` is terminal).

tool_schemas.name: getIntegrationIdentity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated integration identity, including its workspace scope, granted scopes (if any), and current rate-limit/quota status for the identity. Refuses the request if no valid integration identity is authenticated. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the provided integration credential is missing, invalid, or revoked.

integrationIdentityId.description: Optional integration identity ULID (iid_01H...); if omitted, resolves from the presented integration credential.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ULID to assert against the authenticated identity’s workspace scope.

tool_schemas.name: updateWorkspace
tool_schemas.description: Updates workspace fields and/or performs supported lifecycle transitions on a workspace (`active`↔`suspended`, or `deleted`). Returns the updated workspace. Refuses to reactivate a deleted workspace and refuses updates when the authenticated integration identity is not scoped to the workspace. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs or invalid status transitions; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no integration identity is authenticated for the request.

status.description: Lifecycle transition for the workspace: `active`↔`suspended` or `deleted` (terminal).
